title: UCB1: pull the arm that could be best
brief: Score each arm by its mean plus an uncertainty bonus, pull the top score, and watch regret grow only logarithmically.
hints: ucb_bonus divides by the count, so fill the result with np.inf first and write the bonus only where counts > 0.
The bonus uses np.log(t), the total pulls so far, and not np.log(counts). The count goes in the denominator only.
ucb1_scores is means + ucb_bonus(counts, t). An unpulled arm has an infinite bonus, so its score is infinite too.
np.flatnonzero(scores == scores.max()) lists every arm tied for the top score. Pick one with rng.choice, because np.argmax always returns the lowest index.
In the bound, the arms with gap 0 add nothing to the logarithmic sum, so drop them before you divide by the gaps.
